title: Track titles with 'Again'
statementMd:
List tracks whose title ends with the word `Again`. Show the first ten by id.

Expected columns: `id`, `title`.

Tables: `artists`, `albums`, `tracks`, `listeners`, `plays`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT id, title FROM tracks WHERE title LIKE '% Again' ORDER BY id LIMIT 10;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
